content.short: Lightning Network is a decentralized network that uses smart contracts to enable instant Bitcoin payments.
content.description: Lightning Network is a decentralized network that relies on the blockchain's underlying technology. By using real Bitcoin/blockchain transactions and leveraging its native smart-contract scripting language, it builds a secure network of participants that are able to transact at high volume and high speed. This design enables instant Bitcoin payments across the network, supporting frequent, rapid transactions while maintaining the core security principles of Bitcoin.
